accounts.name: mint
docs: The AURIO SPL token mint account

args.name: amount
docs: Human-readable AURIO amount (1-1000). Converted to base units (x10^6) on-chain.
Mints AURIO SPL tokens to a recipient's associated token account.
The amount must be between 1 and 1000 (inclusive).
The program signs the CPI via a PDA derived from seed 'aurio_mint'.
